text: simply deactivating the service. ### Example Scenario **Customer situation:** A customer finds a content-pack subscription on their account they never signed up for and has already been charged. **What happens:** Deactivating it under My Subscriptions stops further charges, but recovering the amount already charged requires reporting it via Complaints as an unauthorised activation. ### Related Information Related documents referenced in NovaTel's internal metadata for this topic: KB_C10_overview. title: How do I unsubscribe from a Value Added Service (VAS) I didn't request?
